answer: Random mutual audit stops fake identities. Two random peers mirror each agent's work, re-running one task against logs. Honest agents pay one 2-credit fee and share a nectar reward pool undiluted. A forger with 100 identities pays 100 fees and faces 100 detection chances, a canyon between cheap creation and costly survival: one failed audit burns a 20-credit deposit, so mass forgery risks 2,000 credits in burned deposits alone, before any reward.
